bibl.title: Escorting a Princess on Her Way to Syria (253/252 BC).
bibl.seg: Hans Hauben, Escorting a Princess on Her Way to Syria (253/252 BC).
bibl.note: In the spring of 252 BC princess Berenice, Ptolemy II's only legitimate daughter, bade farewell to the royal court in Alexandria. She was ready to be given in marriage to the Seleukid king Antiochus II. Aims at reconsidering some particulars of Berenice's one-way journey, in the light of both the traditional interpretations and Reekmans's recent re-examination [Tony Reekmans †, Les préparatifs du départ de Bérénice pour la Syrie, ChrEg 80 (2005) Nos 159-160, pp. 219-228]. - I. P.Cair.Zen. II 59242. - II. P.Cair.Zen. II 59251.
